item.title: Dot Link 0.5.0
item.description: - Improved automatic reconnection to your existing Dot conversation after a Mac restart. - Keep a pending Polar sharing request across restarts so Dot Link does not ask you to set it up again for the same request. - Choose which shared locations, Polar observations, weather forecasts and walking plans your Mac saves. Dot can use them to compare past and current information. Set a retention period or delete records by source in a compatible Even companion. - Add nearby rain estimates in Weather settings on a compatible Even companion. Dot can use recent NOAA satellite estimates alongside MET Norway forecasts. Your existing forecast sharing continues automatically. - Updated bundled components with security fixes.
